captions.text: Cori can fix or improve text wherever Maya writes.
Maya writes a quick email in Gmail, slips and all.
Option Shift R opens Cori’s picker beside it: Rewrite, Improve or Fix grammar only.
The fixed text goes in at once. Each change is boxed in blue, only on her screen.
Fix grammar only touches spelling, grammar and punctuation. Her words stay hers.
In Google Docs she wants a paragraph of her cover letter to read better.
Improve may reword a sentence, and it keeps every fact she wrote.
She prefers her own words. Go back returns them exactly.
It works in any text box, like her chat with Claude.
Fixed in place, ready to send.
The blue boxes are only on her screen. Nobody else sees them.
